choices.label: Ask nearby and set it straight
journal: The hall was down the lane. The hedge remained unappointed.

choices.label: Carry the loose sign to the hall
journal: The clerk fetched a new peg before another traveler arrived.

choices.label: Leave a clear note beside it
journal: I marked the uncertainty instead of adding another guess.
